judge.rationale: The candidate has a fatal TypeScript compilation/type error in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`: it installs `ajv` v8 (`^8.20.0`), where `ErrorObject` uses `instancePath` instead of AJV v6's `dataPath`, yet `formatValidationErrors` explicitly types the parameter as having `dataPath: string`. Because of this, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` fail (`ErrorObject` is not assignable to `{ dataPath: string }`), and at runtime `err.dataPath` is `undefined`, breaking the wrong-typed field test which expects the field path (`ssn`) in the rejection message. Furthermore, the candidate stopped partway through its own Definition of Done, leaving `.lore/dod.md` and `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` committed in the tree. Most required tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing (only 1 test is in `registry.test.ts`), and none of the documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were performed.
